title: Focusing on the Reliability of Voice Agent: xAI Officially Releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0

content_html:
Artificial intelligence company xAI recently announced the launch of its new speech recognition and generation model Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, and it is now fully available to developers. The model has made significant improvements in intelligence level, transcription accuracy, dialogue interaction capabilities, and tool calling efficiency. Its official pricing is $0.08 per minute of audio.

In authoritative speech recognition benchmark tests by Artificial Analysis, Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 achieved a comprehensive score of 82.9%, surpassing its predecessor and outperforming GPT-Realtime-2.1 and Gemini 3.1 Flash. Additionally, its agent capability score reached 56.5%, placing it at the forefront among similar models. In terms of response speed, the model's initial audio playback time has been significantly reduced to 0.70 seconds, providing a smoother interactive experience.

In terms of speech transcription accuracy, official tests show that the new model has improved the transcription accuracy by about 1.4 times compared to the previous generation, demonstrating strong performance in large-scale audio tests across multiple languages. Especially in complex real-world scenarios such as background noise interference and telephone compression, its ability to resist interference has further widened the gap with competitors.

Technically, Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 introduces a speech parallel inference mechanism, significantly reducing system waiting time. Through deep optimization of dialogue strategies using reinforcement learning, the model can produce more concise responses, ensuring that each processing session focuses on a single core issue, thereby significantly improving tool calling efficiency in complex tasks.

Currently, this technology has been verified in real business scenarios and completed A/B testing in Starlink phone services, effectively driving dual improvements in sales conversion rates and customer service response efficiency. According to the official plan, the old version identifier is scheduled to automatically switch to the new version on August 5, 2026.

content_html_zh:
人工智能公司xAI近日宣布推出其全新语音识别和生成模型Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，现已全面向开发者开放。 该模型在智能水平、转录准确性、对话交互能力、工具调用效率等方面都取得了显着提升。 其官方定价为每分钟音频 0.08 美元。

在Artificial Analysis权威语音识别基准测试中，Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0综合得分达到82.9%，超越前代产品，表现优于GPT-Realtime-2.1和Gemini 3.1 Flash。 此外，其座席能力得分达到56.5%，在同类车型中名列前茅。 响应速度方面，该机型的初始音频播放时间大幅缩短至0.70秒，提供更流畅的交互体验。

在语音转录准确度方面，官方测试显示，新模型相比上一代，转录准确率提升约1.4倍，在跨多种语言的大规模音频测试中展现出强劲的表现。 尤其是在背景噪声干扰、电话压缩等复杂的现实场景下，其抗干扰能力进一步拉大了与竞争对手的差距。

技术上，Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0引入了语音并行推理机制，显着减少了系统等待时间。 通过使用强化学习对对话策略进行深度优化，模型可以产生更简洁的响应，确保每个处理会话都专注于单一核心问题，从而显着提高复杂任务中的工具调用效率。

目前，该技术已在实际业务场景中得到验证，并在星链电话服务中完成了A/B测试，有效带动了销售转化率和客户服务响应效率的双重提升。 根据官方计划，旧版本标识符预计于2026年8月5日自动切换至新版本。
